subject: words
title: Ge, ve and wr
about: Three new spellings from CKLA Unit 5: g or ge saying j (gem, large), ve saying v (twelve, give) and wr saying r (wrap, write). Unit 5 calls g a tricky spelling because it can say g or j.
tip: For wr, the w is quiet: have him say the r sound as he taps that first dot.
